g.data-exception-reason: Explicit Index alternatives sample existing continuous geometry near2mm pitch using1.2mm design circles. Close candidate centres below1.5mm are omitted to avoid duplicates, particularly at the hammer head/handle and screwdriver shaft/grip junctions; hidden portions of underlying contours are excluded. Dot contours replace continuous lines within the same master; no colour or height convention conveys meaning and no physical dot mapping is assumed.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse exact continuous definitions and painter order. Each tool surface receives lower grey inside higher black contours. Hammer head covers the hidden handle top; screwdriver grip covers the shaft end. Spanner jaw and hammer claw notch remain white unraised openings. No realistic shading, extra levels or measured heights.
